mapper.insert: /* USE : NaverPlaceEasyLinkMapper.saveNaverPlaceEasyLinkExcelCheck */ INSERT INTO TB_TMP_EXCEL_NAVER_LINK ( SESSION_ID, SEQ, PLACE_ID, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, RESULT ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{placeId}, #{businessName}, #{businessNumber}, #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{result} )
mapper.select: /* USE : NaverPlaceEasyLinkMapper.getNaverPlaceEasyLinkExcelList */ SELECT A.SESSION_ID , A.SEQ , A.PLACE_ID , A.BUSINESS_NAME , A.BUSINESS_NUMBER , A.HQ_OFFICE_CD , C.HQ_OFFICE_NM , A.STORE_CD , D.STORE_NM , D.SYS_STAT_FG , A.RESULT , ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(S.SALE_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_SL_SALE_HDR S WHERE S.STORE_CD = A.STORE_CD AND S.SALE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SALE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1), 'YYYYMMDD') ) AS LAST_SALE_DATE FROM TB_TMP_EXCEL_NAVER_LINK A LEFT JOIN TB_HQ_OFFICE C ON A.HQ_OFFICE_CD = C.HQ_OFFICE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MS_STORE D ON A.STORE_CD = D.STORE_CD WHERE A.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} ORDER BY A.SEQ
mapper.update: /* USE : NaverPlaceEasyLinkMapper.saveNaverPlaceEasyLinkExcel */ MERGE INTO TB_CM_NAVER_LINK A USING DUAL ON ( A.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND A.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.NAVER_STORE_NM = #{businessName}, A.NAVER_PLACE_ID = #{placeId}, A.NAVER_LINK_DT = #{modDt}, A.IN_TYPE = 'NAVER', A.MOD_DT = #{modDt}, A.MOD_ID = #{modId} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, NAVER_STORE_NM, NAVER_PLACE_ID, NAVER_LINK_DT, IN_TYPE, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{businessName}, #{placeId}, #{modDt}, 'NAVER', #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
